data.name: Touhou Stack Music Pack
data.teaser: "Stack is my Religion."   Adds over 300+ Songs from Akatsuki Records
data.description:
Hey I’m back. I finally finished this Music Pack. This is Akatsuki Records Stack Music mod which adds over 300 songs, the majority of if not all of their music. All the music in this belongs to Stack and Akatsuki Records and all credit goes to them for their wonderful music.

Submod to Bobby’s Main menu music Mod

Install: Drag the BepinEx folder into your SPT directory.

Note: There may be repeats in this music list. if you hear any, grab the music title or song name and a clip if you can. so that I may remove any repeats.

Otherwise, Enjoy! Updated to 3.10.X SPT

whoops forgot preview: https://youtu.be/pP2NPHiHEKg?si=VKDDBM426B-FCK-r

WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop. (This still applies to SPT 3.11 version for all Music mods) Upgraded mod to SPT 3.11 version.
